Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign forcibly downloads an Android APK to users' devices via malicious ads on a popular forum
First app (kskas.apk) mimics an Android cleaner app and triggers a popup mimicking a security update with no cancel option
Popup forces user to click OK, which downloads and installs a second app named 'update'
Second app requests admin rights and uses them to show ads on the user's screen
App prevents uninstallation by freezing the device when attempts are made to revoke admin rights
Attack Vector: Malicious ads on GodLike Productions forum forcibly downloading APKs
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious ads on GodLike Productions forum
Second app named 'update' requesting admin rights
Device freezing behavior when attempting to uninstall 'update' app
